title: Editors cannot change a site domain

clarifications.edition: Community Edition. Use MIX_ENV=ce_test, which is already set. PostgreSQL and ClickHouse are ready inside the offline workspace network.
clarifications.verification: Add or update a *_test.exs regression test under test/. It must expose the reported defect in the original code and pass with your repair. Existing checks must remain valid.

source_inspiration.note: Actual upstream broken snapshot and accepted repair. See provenance.json for commit and tree identities.

partial_repair_probe.description: Allow editors but also grant the operation to viewers

required_acceptance_tests: Elixir.Plausible.Benchmark.AuditDomainScopeTest::test a guest editor of one site is still a viewer of another site in that team
Elixir.Plausible.Benchmark.AuditDomainScopeTest::test an editor role on one team does not grant access to another team's site
